dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: Those who stand at high places are always staring at their feet, so they can easily overlook dangers coming from above. They should be more careful...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this area especially prone to accidents?

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: See the cliffs around here? There are basically no fences in sight.

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: My people are at least used to it — we've all gotten picked up by Yumkasaurs at some point in our lives.

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: So if you were to hear someone suddenly miss their step and start screaming, chances are they're an outlander friend.

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: Usually, it'd just be some small scratches.

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: The ones who get seriously hurt around here are those who are into serious challenges and extreme sports.

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: Oh, and just between the two of us, if you ever find someone seriously injured but without the help of a doctor, please feel free to bring them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: I actually know some first aid techniques, but please don't tell anyone else about it!

dialogues.speaker: Yawar
dialogues.text: If those crazy kids ever hear that I'd be able to save them, they'll just feel compelled to try even more dangerous tricks.
